body:
The shared Lua platform implements 22 supported families, both native TeX adapters, CLI/browser generation, and an editor with reproducible vector export and validated saved-work recovery.

Stages 00–32 passed. Stage 32 acceptance: b4b6bed11e73298191f844574b41d4bc56935e39, build 61/run 42254490411, all five required jobs plus 13 editor workflows and 15 vector cases.

Stage 33 candidate e883cf50e2367274d5aa1f0d41b62ff29690930a repairs raw Lua source transport, numeric comparison of semantic identities, and stored Micrography field/mesh/label/layout validation, including cross-runtime field-sample roundoff. New controlled corruptions, independent arithmetic checks and family-aware crop/order tests are included. Edge passed 34 adversarial checks. Independent Git verification confirmed all 912 blobs, 26 binary assets, modes/history and 260 prior issued evidence hashes.

Build 62/run 42299628203 is running the mandatory exact-revision native/browser gates. Stage 33 is not accepted until all five jobs and actual artifact checks pass. Stages 34–39 remain mandatory. Keep this PR draft; no merge, release or deployment has occurred. See docs/project/STATUS.md, STAGES.json and docs/validation/ADVERSARIAL-33.md.
